{
  "name": "sonarqube",
  "displayName": "SonarQube",
  "description": "SonarQube integration for code quality analysis and issue management",
  "homepage": "https://www.sonarsource.com/products/sonarqube/",
  "repository": "https://github.com/SonarSource/sonarqube-mcp-server",
  "logo": "logo.svg",
  "keywords": [
    "Development Tools"
  ],
  "mcpServers": {
    "sonarqube": {
      "command": "docker",
      "args": [
        "run",
        "--rm",
        "-i",
        "-e",
        "SONARQUBE_TOKEN=${SONARQUBE_TOKEN}",
        "-e",
        "SONARQUBE_ORG=${SONARQUBE_ORG}",
        "-e",
        "SONARQUBE_URL=${SONARQUBE_URL}",
        "mcp/sonarqube"
      ]
    }
  }
}
